dedupe_keys.name: 水利署水利防災用影像 fire police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 水利署水利防災用影像 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 資料集描述： 本資料為記錄水利署於全台所建置之121處水情影像監視站共163支攝影機，從2005年起以每十分鐘一張的頻率記錄，自2020年9月起改以每分鐘一張記錄，對河川歷年演變情況進行長時間觀測，並提供防災與環境保育相關之影像加值與研究之用。 另一方面由於大多數水位量測器都在水岸邊，常因洪水或水位暴漲而遭沖毀故障，以至於水情監測資料無法... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
